name: Executor-class Star Dreadnought
description: The Executor-class Star Dreadnought, also known as the Super-class Star Destroyer, was the largest model of Star Destroyer ever built by the Galactic Empire. At 19 kilometers in length, it served as Darth Vader's flagship and was one of the most feared vessels in the galaxy.

name: Imperial I-class Star Destroyer
description: The Imperial I-class Star Destroyer was the signature vessel of the Imperial Navy. At 1,600 meters long, these wedge-shaped warships were designed to inspire fear and project Imperial power across the galaxy.

name: Venator-class Star Destroyer
description: The Venator-class Star Destroyer, also known as the Republic Attack Cruiser, was the primary capital ship of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars and early Imperial period.

name: Acclamator-class Assault Ship
description: The Acclamator-class assault ship was a cruiser used by the Galactic Republic for planetary assaults during the Clone Wars.

name: Gladiator-class Star Destroyer
description: The Gladiator-class Star Destroyer was the smallest Star Destroyer in the Imperial arsenal, designed for patrol and escort duties.

name: Victory I-class Star Destroyer
description: The Victory I-class Star Destroyer was a predecessor to the Imperial-class, known for its heavy planetary bombardment capabilities.

name: Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser
description: The Interdictor-class heavy cruiser was equipped with gravity well projectors to prevent enemy ships from escaping to hyperspace.

name: Resurgent-class Star Destroyer
description: The Resurgent-class Star Destroyer was a major warship class used by the First Order, significantly larger and more powerful than Imperial-era designs.

name: Mega-class Star Dreadnought (Supremacy)
description: The Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy was Supreme Leader Snoke's flagship and the mobile headquarters of the First Order. At 13km long and 60km wide, it was wider than it was long.

name: Xyston-class Star Destroyer
description: The Xyston-class Star Destroyer was based on an upscaled Imperial I-class design and featured an axial superlaser capable of destroying planets.

name: Onager-class Star Destroyer
description: The Onager-class Star Destroyer was a specialized siege platform equipped with a superweapon capable of devastating planetary targets.

name: Secutor-class Star Destroyer
description: The Secutor-class Star Destroyer was one of the largest starfighter carriers in the Imperial Navy.

name: MC80 Home One-type Star Cruiser
description: The MC80 Home One-type Star Cruiser was Admiral Ackbar's flagship and served as the Rebel Alliance's primary command vessel during the Battle of Endor.

name: MC80 Liberty-type Star Cruiser
description: The MC80 Liberty-type Star Cruiser was a variant of the MC80 line with a distinct winged design.

name: MC75 Star Cruiser
description: The MC75 Star Cruiser was a converted city-ship that served as a powerful warship for the Rebel Alliance.

name: MC30c Frigate
description: The MC30c frigate was a fast, heavily armed Mon Calamari warship used by the Rebel Alliance.

name: CR90 Corvette (Blockade Runner)
description: The CR90 corvette, famously known as the Blockade Runner, was a versatile and fast vessel used by both the Republic and Rebel Alliance.

name: GR-75 Medium Transport
description: The GR-75 medium transport was a workhorse of the Rebel Alliance fleet, used for transporting supplies and personnel.

name: Nebulon-B Frigate
description: The EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate was used by both the Empire and Rebel Alliance, with the Rebels famously converting one into a medical frigate.

name: Hammerhead Corvette
description: The Hammerhead corvette was an ancient design that saw renewed service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

name: Sphyrna-class Corvette (Hammerhead)
description: The Sphyrna-class corvette, commonly known as the Hammerhead corvette, was famously used to ram Imperial Star Destroyers.

name: Lucrehulk-class Battleship
description: The Lucrehulk-class battleship was a massive converted freighter that served as the Trade Federation's primary warship.

name: Providence-class Dreadnought
description: The Providence-class Dreadnought was the Separatist Alliance's primary capital ship, serving as Count Dooku's and General Grievous's flagship.

name: Recusant-class Light Destroyer
description: The Recusant-class light destroyer was a Separatist warship known for its distinctive thin profile.

name: Munificent-class Star Frigate
description: The Munificent-class star frigate was the workhorse of the Separatist fleet, heavily armed for its size.

name: Subjugator-class Heavy Cruiser (Malevolence)
description: The Subjugator-class heavy cruiser, exemplified by the Malevolence, was a massive warship equipped with an ion pulse cannon capable of disabling entire fleets.

name: Arquitens-class Light Cruiser
description: The Arquitens-class light cruiser served in both the Republic and Imperial navies as an escort vessel.

name: Consular-class Cruiser (Charger c70)
description: The Consular-class cruiser was a diplomatic vessel that could be retrofitted for combat as the Charger c70.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701 (Constitution-class)
description: The Constitution-class USS Enterprise NCC-1701 was Starfleet's flagship heavy cruiser under Captain James T. Kirk, designed for deep-space exploration.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701-D (Galaxy-class)
description: The Galaxy-class USS Enterprise NCC-1701-D was Captain Jean-Luc Picard's flagship, representing the pinnacle of Federation exploration technology.

name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701-E (Sovereign-class)
description: The Sovereign-class USS Enterprise NCC-1701-E was one of Starfleet's most advanced vessels, designed to combat the Borg threat.

name: USS Defiant NX-74205
description: The Defiant-class was a compact, heavily armed warship designed specifically to combat the Borg.

name: USS Voyager NCC-74656 (Intrepid-class)
description: The Intrepid-class USS Voyager was a science vessel that became stranded in the Delta Quadrant for seven years.

name: USS Discovery NCC-1031 (Crossfield-class)
description: The Crossfield-class USS Discovery was an experimental science vessel equipped with the revolutionary spore drive.

name: Deep Space 9 (Cardassian Nor-class)
description: Deep Space 9 was a former Cardassian mining station that became a crucial Federation outpost and trade hub near the Bajoran wormhole.

name: Klingon Bird-of-Prey (B'rel-class)
description: The B'rel-class Bird-of-Prey was a versatile Klingon scout vessel equipped with cloaking technology.

name: Klingon Vor'cha-class Attack Cruiser
description: The Vor'cha-class attack cruiser was one of the Klingon Empire's most powerful warships.

name: Klingon Negh'Var-class Warship
description: The Negh'Var-class was the largest and most powerful warship in the Klingon fleet, serving as the Chancellor's flagship.

name: Romulan D'deridex-class Warbird
description: The D'deridex-class warbird was the Romulan Star Empire's primary capital ship, known for its distinctive green color and cloaking device.

name: Romulan Valdore-type Warbird
description: The Valdore-type warbird was a more compact and maneuverable design than the D'deridex-class.

name: Borg Cube
description: The Borg Cube was the primary vessel of the Borg Collective, a massive cube-shaped ship capable of assimilating entire civilizations.

name: Borg Sphere
description: The Borg Sphere was a spherical vessel used for scouting, time travel, and as an escape vessel from damaged cubes.

name: Jem'Hadar Battlecruiser
description: The Jem'Hadar battlecruiser was the Dominion's primary heavy warship during the Dominion War.

name: Jem'Hadar Fighter
description: The Jem'Hadar fighter was a small, heavily armed attack ship used for hit-and-run tactics.

name: Cardassian Galor-class Warship
description: The Galor-class warship was the backbone of the Cardassian military.

name: Ferengi D'Kora-class Marauder
description: The D'Kora-class marauder was a Ferengi vessel used for both commerce and combat.

name: Species 8472 Bioship
description: Species 8472 bioships were organic vessels from fluidic space, capable of destroying Borg cubes.

name: Emperor-class Battleship
description: The Emperor-class battleship is the poster ship of Battlefleet Gothic, serving as a battlecarrier with massive fighter and bomber capacity alongside heavy armaments.

name: Retribution-class Battleship
description: The Retribution-class battleship is the Imperial Navy's ship of the line, capable of devastating broadside assaults.

name: Apocalypse-class Battleship
description: The Apocalypse-class battleship is a long-ranged sniper vessel equipped with powerful lance batteries and a Nova Cannon.

name: Oberon-class Battleship
description: The Oberon-class battleship was designed to handle any threat without escort support.

name: Mars-class Battlecruiser
description: The Mars-class battlecruiser combines lance batteries with launch bays for versatile combat capability.

name: Lunar-class Cruiser
description: The Lunar-class cruiser is the workhorse of the Imperial Navy, forming the backbone of most battlefleets.

name: Tyrant-class Cruiser
description: The Tyrant-class cruiser is armed with powerful macrocannon batteries for devastating firepower.

name: Gothic-class Cruiser
description: The Gothic-class cruiser specializes in lance weaponry for precise, long-range destruction.

name: Dauntless-class Light Cruiser
description: The Dauntless-class light cruiser serves as a scout and fast attack vessel for the Imperial Navy.

name: Firestorm-class Frigate
description: The Firestorm-class frigate mounts a prow lance for armor-piercing attacks.

name: Sword-class Frigate
description: The Sword-class frigate is a common escort vessel in Imperial battlefleets.

name: Cobra-class Destroyer
description: The Cobra-class destroyer is a fast torpedo boat used for hit-and-run attacks.

name: Avenger-class Grand Cruiser
description: The Avenger-class grand cruiser is an ancient and venerable design still serving the Imperium.

name: Chaos Despoiler-class Battleship
description: The Despoiler-class battleship is a Chaos vessel often infested with daemons and corrupted by the Warp.

name: Chaos Retaliator-class Grand Cruiser
description: The Retaliator-class grand cruiser serves Chaos warfleets with devastating firepower.

name: Eldar Craftworld
description: An Eldar Craftworld is a massive world-ship housing the remnants of the ancient Eldar empire, each containing billions of souls.

name: Void Stalker-class Battleship (Eldar)
description: The Void Stalker-class is the largest Eldar warship, combining speed with devastating firepower.

name: Ork Kroozer
description: Ork kroozers are ramshackle but deadly vessels built from salvaged and looted ships.

name: Tyranid Hive Ship
description: Tyranid Hive Ships are massive organic vessels that serve as the primary bio-ships of the Hive Fleet.

name: Necron Cairn-class Tomb Ship
description: The Cairn-class Tomb Ship is a Necron vessel of living metal, nearly indestructible and armed with devastating gauss weaponry.

name: UNSC Infinity
description: The UNSC Infinity was the largest and most advanced warship ever constructed by humanity, equipped with reverse-engineered Forerunner technology.

name: UNSC Pillar of Autumn (Halcyon-class)
description: The Pillar of Autumn was a Halcyon-class light cruiser that played a crucial role in the Human-Covenant War.

name: UNSC Forward Unto Dawn (Charon-class)
description: The Forward Unto Dawn was a Charon-class light frigate that served in the final battles of the Human-Covenant War.

name: UNSC Spirit of Fire (Phoenix-class)
description: The Spirit of Fire was a Phoenix-class colony ship converted for military support operations.

name: UNSC Savannah (Paris-class)
description: The Paris-class heavy frigate was a powerful UNSC escort vessel.

name: UNSC Marathon-class Heavy Cruiser
description: The Marathon-class heavy cruiser was the primary capital ship of the UNSC Navy during the Human-Covenant War.

name: Covenant CAS-class Assault Carrier
description: The CAS-class assault carrier was one of the largest vessels in the Covenant fleet, serving as flagships for fleet masters.

name: Covenant CSO-class Supercarrier
description: The CSO-class supercarrier was the largest vessel in the Covenant fleet, capable of carrying entire invasion forces.

name: Covenant DDS-class Carrier
description: The DDS-class carrier was a dedicated fighter carrier used by the Covenant.

name: Covenant CCS-class Battlecruiser
description: The CCS-class battlecruiser was the most common capital ship in the Covenant fleet.

name: Covenant CPV-class Heavy Destroyer
description: The CPV-class heavy destroyer was often used for glassing operations and excavation of Forerunner sites.

name: Covenant SDV-class Heavy Corvette
description: The SDV-class heavy corvette served as an escort and scout vessel for the Covenant.

name: Forerunner Mantle's Approach
description: Mantle's Approach was the Didact's personal fortress, a massive Forerunner vessel equipped with the Composer.

name: Forerunner Keyship (Anodyne Spirit)
description: Forerunner Keyships were ancient vessels capable of activating the Halo Array and opening portals to the Ark.

name: Banished Enduring Conviction (CAS-class)
description: The Enduring Conviction was Atriox's flagship, a CAS-class assault carrier under Banished control.

name: Reaper Sovereign-class
description: Sovereign was a Reaper vanguard left behind to trigger the next cycle of extinction. At 2km long, it was a terrifying force that could indoctrinate organic minds.

name: Reaper Destroyer
description: Reaper Destroyers were smaller but still deadly Reaper vessels used for planetary assaults.

name: Reaper Harbinger
description: Harbinger was the first and oldest Reaper, leading the assault on the galaxy.

name: Systems Alliance Normandy SR-2
description: The Normandy SR-2 was a Cerberus-built stealth frigate that became Commander Shepard's flagship.

name: Systems Alliance Normandy SR-1
description: The Normandy SR-1 was the original prototype stealth reconnaissance frigate.

name: Systems Alliance SSV Everest (Cruiser)
description: Systems Alliance cruisers formed the backbone of the Alliance Navy.

name: Systems Alliance Dreadnought
description: Systems Alliance dreadnoughts were kilometer-long vessels armed with powerful mass accelerator cannons.

name: Asari Destiny Ascension
description: The Destiny Ascension was the most powerful warship in the Citadel Fleet and the Asari flagship.

name: Asari Cruiser
description: Asari cruisers were known for their elegant design and powerful biotic capabilities.

name: Turian Dreadnought
description: Turian dreadnoughts were the military backbone of the Turian Hierarchy.

name: Geth Dreadnought
description: The Geth Dreadnought was a massive synthetic vessel housing millions of Geth programs.

name: Collector Cruiser
description: The Collector Cruiser was a mysterious vessel used by the Collectors to abduct human colonies.

name: Quarian Migrant Fleet Ship
description: The Quarian Migrant Fleet consisted of thousands of ships housing the entire Quarian population.

name: Cerberus Cruiser
description: Cerberus cruisers were advanced warships built by the pro-human organization.

name: SSV Normandy SR-2 Cerberus
description: The Cerberus-built Normandy SR-2 was significantly larger and more advanced than the original.

name: Battlestar Galactica (Jupiter-class)
description: The Battlestar Galactica was a Jupiter-class battlestar that survived the Cylon attack and led the refugee fleet to Earth.

name: Battlestar Pegasus (Mercury-class)
description: The Battlestar Pegasus was a newer Mercury-class battlestar with advanced capabilities.

name: Colonial One
description: Colonial One was the presidential transport that became the seat of government after the Cylon attack.

name: Cylon Basestar (Modern)
description: The modern Cylon Basestar was a biomechanical vessel controlled by hybrid consciousness.

name: Cylon Basestar (Original)
description: The original Cylon Basestar was a double-saucer design from the first Cylon War.

name: Cylon Raider
description: The Cylon Raider was a sentient biomechanical fighter craft.

name: Colonial Viper Mk II
description: The Viper Mk II was the primary space superiority fighter of the Colonial Fleet.

name: Colonial Viper Mk VII
description: The Viper Mk VII was the advanced next-generation fighter before the Cylon attack.

name: Colonial Raptor
description: The Raptor was a multi-role craft used for reconnaissance, electronic warfare, and transport.

name: Cloud 9
description: Cloud 9 was a luxury liner with massive pressurized dome environments.

name: BC-304 Daedalus-class (Deep Space Carrier)
description: The BC-304 Daedalus-class was Earth's first deep space carrier, equipped with Asgard technology and beam weapons.

name: BC-303 Prometheus
description: The BC-303 Prometheus was Earth's first interstellar battlecruiser, later destroyed in battle.

name: F-302 Fighter-Interceptor
description: The F-302 was Earth's first production space superiority fighter, capable of both atmospheric and space combat.

name: Goa'uld Ha'tak
description: The Ha'tak was the standard Goa'uld mothership, a pyramid-shaped vessel used by System Lords.

name: Goa'uld Al'kesh
description: The Al'kesh was a Goa'uld mid-range bomber and support vessel.

name: Goa'uld Death Glider
description: The Death Glider was the primary Goa'uld fighter for both atmospheric and space combat.

name: Asgard O'Neill-class
description: The O'Neill-class was the most advanced Asgard warship, named after Colonel Jack O'Neill.

name: Asgard Bilskirnir-class
description: The Bilskirnir-class was a powerful Asgard warship, Thor's vessel of choice.

name: Ancient Aurora-class Battleship
description: The Aurora-class battleship was one of the most powerful Ancient warships, equipped with drone weapons.

name: Ancient Destiny
description: Destiny was an Ancient exploration vessel launched millions of years ago to explore the universe.

name: Ancient Puddle Jumper
description: The Puddle Jumper was a small Ancient shuttle capable of time travel and fitting through Stargates.

name: Ori Warship
description: Ori warships were massive vessels built using knowledge from the Ori, equipped with powerful energy weapons.

name: Wraith Hive Ship
description: Wraith Hive Ships were massive organic vessels that served as mobile bases for Wraith hives.

name: Wraith Cruiser
description: Wraith cruisers were smaller but faster organic vessels used for support and culling operations.

name: Wraith Dart
description: The Wraith Dart was a small fighter used for culling humans and combat.

name: Replicator Cruiser
description: Replicator cruisers were vessels constructed from replicator blocks, capable of self-repair.

name: MCRN Donnager-class Battleship
description: The MCRN Donnager was one of the largest battleships ever commissioned by Mars, almost 500 meters long.

name: MCRN Tachi/Rocinante (Corvette-class)
description: The Tachi, later renamed Rocinante, was a Martian corvette that became the protagonists' ship.

name: UNN Truman-class Dreadnought
description: The UNN Truman-class dreadnought was Earth's primary capital ship, smaller than Martian counterparts.

name: MCRN Scirocco-class Assault Cruiser
description: The Scirocco-class assault cruiser was a Martian vessel designed for planetary assault operations.

name: Nauvoo/Behemoth/Medina Station
description: The Nauvoo was a massive generation ship built by the Mormon Church, later converted into the Behemoth and then Medina Station.

name: Canterbury (Ice Hauler)
description: The Canterbury was a large ice hauler transporting water from Saturn to the Belt.

name: Anubis (Stealth Ship)
description: The Anubis was a Protogen stealth ship involved in the protomolecule conspiracy.

name: Razorback (Racing Pinnace)
description: The Razorback was Julie Mao's racing pinnace, one of the fastest ships in the system.

name: Knight (Shuttle)
description: The Knight was a utility shuttle aboard the Canterbury.

name: UNN Agatha King (Raptor-class)
description: The UNN Agatha King was a Raptor-class cruiser in the UNN fleet.

name: Omega-class Destroyer
description: The Omega-class Destroyer was the most powerful ship in the Earth Alliance Star-Navy, combining heavy firepower with fighter support.

name: Hyperion-class Heavy Cruiser
description: The Hyperion-class heavy cruiser was an older but still formidable Earth Alliance warship.

name: Nova-class Dreadnought
description: The Nova-class dreadnought was the predecessor to the Omega-class, heavily armed but lacking fighter capability.

name: White Star-class Destroyer
description: The White Star-class was an advanced Minbari-Ranger vessel combining Vorlon and Minbari technology.

name: Sharlin-class Warcruiser (Minbari)
description: The Sharlin-class warcruiser was the Minbari Federation's primary capital ship, nearly unbeatable in combat.

name: Nial-class Fighter (Minbari)
description: The Nial was the Minbari's advanced fighter, superior to most other craft.

name: G'Quan-class Heavy Cruiser (Narn)
description: The G'Quan-class heavy cruiser was the Narn Regime's primary capital ship.

name: Primus-class Battlecruiser (Centauri)
description: The Primus-class battlecruiser was the Centauri Republic's most powerful warship.

name: Vorchan-class Medium Warship (Centauri)
description: The Vorchan-class was a fast, versatile medium warship used by the Centauri.

name: Shadow Battlecrab
description: Shadow Battlecrabs were organic vessels of the ancient Shadows, designed to inspire terror.

name: Shadow Scout
description: Shadow Scouts were smaller organic vessels used for reconnaissance.

name: Vorlon Dreadnought
description: Vorlon Dreadnoughts were among the most powerful vessels of the First Ones.

name: Vorlon Transport
description: Vorlon Transports were mysterious vessels used for diplomatic and transport purposes.

name: Babylon 5 Station
description: Babylon 5 was a massive O'Neill-class space station serving as a diplomatic hub and trade center.

name: Spacing Guild Heighliner
description: Guild Heighliners were immense starships, upwards of twenty kilometers in length, used to transport people and equipment across the known universe via foldspace.

name: USCSS Nostromo (Lockmart CM-88B Bison)
description: The USCSS Nostromo was a modified Lockmart CM-88B Bison M-Class star freighter that encountered the xenomorph.

name: USCSS Covenant (Model CY78.3 Affiance)
description: The USCSS Covenant was an extended range colony ship carrying 2,000 colonists bound for Origae-6.

name: USCSS Prometheus (Scientific Exploratory Vessel)
description: The USCSS Prometheus was a scientific exploratory vessel sent to LV-223 to find the Engineers.

name: USS Sulaco (Conestoga-class)
description: The USS Sulaco was a Conestoga-class troop carrier transporting Colonial Marines to LV-426.

name: The Betty (Betty-class)
description: The Betty was an unregistered freighter used by mercenaries in Alien Resurrection.

name: USM Auriga
description: The USM Auriga was a large military research vessel where xenomorph cloning experiments took place.

name: Engineer Juggernaut
description: The Engineer Juggernaut was an ancient vessel designed for transporting bioweapons.

name: Avatar-class Titan (Amarr)
description: The Avatar-class Titan is the Amarr Empire's ultimate weapon, capable of unleashing doomsday weapons.

name: Erebus-class Titan (Gallente)
description: The Erebus-class Titan is the Gallente Federation's massive capital ship.

name: Leviathan-class Titan (Caldari)
description: The Leviathan-class Titan is the Caldari State's largest vessel, specializing in missile warfare.

name: Ragnarok-class Titan (Minmatar)
description: The Ragnarok-class Titan is the Minmatar Republic's massive capital ship.

name: Revenant-class Supercarrier
description: The Revenant-class Supercarrier is a rare Sansha's Nation vessel.

name: Wyvern-class Supercarrier (Caldari)
description: The Wyvern-class Supercarrier is the Caldari State's fighter carrier.

name: Aeon-class Supercarrier (Amarr)
description: The Aeon-class Supercarrier is the Amarr Empire's heavy fighter carrier.

name: Moros-class Dreadnought (Gallente)
description: The Moros-class Dreadnought is the Gallente Federation's siege platform.

name: Apocalypse-class Battleship (Amarr)
description: The Apocalypse-class Battleship is an Amarr laser-armed warship.

name: Raven-class Battleship (Caldari)
description: The Raven-class Battleship is the Caldari State's missile platform.

name: Megathron-class Battleship (Gallente)
description: The Megathron-class Battleship is the Gallente Federation's primary battleship.

name: Tempest-class Battleship (Minmatar)
description: The Tempest-class Battleship is the Minmatar Republic's versatile warship.

name: Hyperion (Behemoth-class Battlecruiser)
description: The Hyperion is Jim Raynor's flagship, a Behemoth-class battlecruiser and mobile base for Raynor's Raiders.

name: Bucephalus (Gorgon-class Battlecruiser)
description: The Bucephalus was Emperor Arcturus Mengsk's flagship, a Gorgon-class battlecruiser.

name: Leviathan (Zerg)
description: The Leviathan is a massive Zerg space creature that serves as a capital ship and mobile hive.

name: Carrier (Protoss)
description: The Protoss Carrier is a massive capital ship that deploys swarms of robotic Interceptors.

name: Mothership (Protoss)
description: The Protoss Mothership is a rare and powerful vessel equipped with planet-destroying capabilities.

name: Void Ray (Protoss)
description: The Void Ray is a Protoss warship armed with a prismatic beam that intensifies over time.

name: Battlecruiser (Minotaur-class)
description: The Minotaur-class battlecruiser is the Dominion's standard capital ship.

name: Science Vessel
description: The Science Vessel is a Terran support vessel used for research and detection.

name: Overlord (Zerg)
description: The Overlord is a Zerg support creature used for command, detection, and transport.

name: Mutalisk (Zerg)
description: The Mutalisk is a Zerg air unit that fires Glave Wurms at targets.

name: Dreadnaught (Oryx's)
description: Oryx's Dreadnaught is a massive Hive fortress carved from the corpse of the Worm God Akka, capable of destroying worlds.

name: Leviathan (Calus's)
description: The Leviathan is Emperor Calus's massive world-eating ship, capable of consuming planets.

name: Hive Tombship
description: Hive Tombships are organic dropships used to transport Hive forces.

name: Fallen Ketch
description: The Fallen Ketch is a medium warship used by Eliksni Houses.

name: Fallen Skiff
description: Fallen Skiffs are small transport vessels used for troop deployment.

name: Cabal Harvester
description: Cabal Harvesters are heavy dropships used for planetary assault.

name: Cabal Thresher
description: Cabal Threshers are gunships providing air support to ground forces.

name: Vex Gate Lord
description: Gate Lords are massive Vex units that defend key Vex gates.

name: jumpship (Guardian)
description: Guardian jumpships are personal spacecraft used for travel between destinations.

name: SCV-70 White Base (Pegasus-class)
description: The White Base was the Earth Federation's prototype assault carrier that launched the Gundam into battle.

name: Argama-class (Argama)
description: The Argama-class assault cruiser was the AEUG's flagship during the Gryps Conflict.

name: Nahel Argama
description: The Nahel Argama was a modified Argama-class cruiser that served as the Londo Bell flagship.

name: Musai-class (Zeon)
description: The Musai-class light cruiser was the Principality of Zeon's primary warship.

name: Gwazine-class (Zeon)
description: The Gwazine-class battleship was Zeon's largest and most powerful warship.

name: Salamis-class (Federation)
description: The Salamis-class cruiser was the Earth Federation's standard warship before the One Year War.

name: Magellan-class (Federation)
description: The Magellan-class battleship was the Earth Federation's primary capital ship before mobile suits.

name: Ra Cailum-class
description: The Ra Cailum-class battleship was a modern design serving as the Londo Bell flagship.

name: Archangel (LCAM-01XA)
description: The Archangel was an Earth Alliance assault ship that became famous during the Bloody Valentine War.

name: Minerva (ZAFT)
description: The Minerva was a ZAFT assault ship serving as a mobile suit carrier.

name: Ptolemaios (CBS-70)
description: The Ptolemaios was Celestial Being's mobile suit assault carrier, home to the Gundam Meisters.

name: Diva (Assault Cruiser)
description: The Diva was an Earth Federation assault cruiser during the A.G. era.

name: SDF-1 Macross
description: The SDF-1 Macross was a Super Dimension Fortress that could transform into a humanoid configuration.

name: SDF-2 Megaroad
description: The SDF-2 Megaroad was a long-range emigration fleet flagship.

name: Macross Quarter
description: The Macross Quarter was a smaller variable assault carrier used by SMS.

name: Macross Frontier (Island 1)
description: Macross Frontier's Island 1 was a massive city ship housing millions of colonists.

name: Zentraedi Nupetiet-Vergnitzs-class Flagship
description: The Nupetiet-Vergnitzs-class was the Zentraedi's largest and most powerful flagship.

name: Zentraedi Queadol-Magdomilla-class Command Ship
description: The Queadol-Magdomilla-class was a Zentraedi command ship used for fleet control.

name: Zentraedi Thuverl-Salan-class Destroyer
description: The Thuverl-Salan-class destroyer was a common Zentraedi warship.

name: VF-1 Valkyrie
description: The VF-1 Valkyrie was the first mass-produced variable fighter capable of transforming between fighter, gerwalk, and battroid modes.

name: Brünhild (Galactic Empire)
description: The Brünhild was Reinhard von Lohengramm's personal flagship, an experimental battleship with unique fluid metal armor.

name: Barbarossa (Galactic Empire)
description: The Barbarossa was Siegfried Kircheis's flagship, painted in his signature red color.

name: Wilhelmina (Galactic Empire)
description: The Wilhelmina-class was a standard Imperial flagship design used by high-ranking admirals.

name: Hyperion (Free Planets Alliance)
description: The Hyperion was Yang Wen-li's flagship, a legendary vessel that led the Alliance to many victories.

name: Patroklos (Free Planets Alliance)
